title: JRC TMF first-deforestation and first-degradation year per first-level region (Southeast Asia, 11 countries)

units.deforested_ha: hectares whose FIRST deforestation year is that year (1990 bucket includes 1984-1990)
units.degraded_ha: hectares whose FIRST degradation year is that year (1990 bucket includes 1984-1990)
units.plantation_conversion_ha_static: hectares in TMF transition class 41 (deforested land converted to tree plantations, end 2025)

notes: Source: JRC TMF v1.2025 (Vancutsem et al. 2021), 30 m, DeforestationYear / DegradationYear / TransitionMap_MainClasses.
TMF covers humid tropical forest only (not dry forest/savanna), so values are lower than Hansen loss; in the drier north (Thailand, Myanmar, Laos, Vietnam) it covers only part of the forest.
Degradation = temporary canopy disturbance not followed by deforestation (includes fire-damaged forest).
Regions: geoBoundaries ADM1; each country is counted on its own.
Indonesian, Malaysian, Brunei and Singapore series are the live / tier-B values unchanged (a rebuild of them in the same run matched; see build report).
Series 'all' = sum of the 11 national series (null where any country has no data for the field).
